TRAINING

Training guide

How training relates to strength, confidence, and competition readiness.

Official-source overviewReviewed Nov 6, 2026
THE QUICK ANSWER

Training exercises develop your horse’s strength and confidence toward competition readiness. The publisher also identifies desensitization training among the features added before launch.

Train toward a goal#

Choose a competition or in-game goal, then read its stated requirements. Planning backward from that requirement is more useful than assuming every available exercise develops the same ability. Exact gains by exercise are not verified here.

Confidence and desensitization#

Confidence is part of the official training description, and desensitization is a confirmed training feature. A complete mapping between exercises, behavior changes, and numerical gains requires playtesting.

New courses and upgrades#

Advanced building stages can unlock training courses. If a course is unavailable, inspect your building’s current upgrade panel for the requirements shown in your version.

What still needs verification

Research note

Per-session gains, limits, fatigue behavior, and the best schedule need in-game testing.

This page reflects official descriptions reviewed on November 6, 2026. It has not been verified against a specific playable build. Suggestions are editorial guidance, not tested outcomes.

Frequently asked questions

What does training develop?+

The official store names strength and confidence.

Is desensitization included?+

Yes, the publisher identifies it in the launch article.

What is the fastest training schedule?+

No optimal schedule has been tested for this wiki.
